summary.text: Alek Skarlatos is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 4 who has served since January 13, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Alek Skarlatos served in the Oregon Army National Guard from 2012 to 2017.

In August 2015, he and four others stopped a terrorist attack on a Paris-bound train traveling from Amsterdam, and he received honors including the U.S. Army's Soldier's Medal and France's Legion of Honor.
Skarlatos was the Republican candidate for U.S. House in Oregon's 4th Congressional District in 2020, when Peter DeFazio won the general election, and again in 2022, when Val Hoyle won it.
He succeeded Christine Goodwin in the Oregon House when he took office in 2025.
